project_name.justification: Wallbridge Announces Option Agreement to Sell 100% Interest of Non-Core N2 Property to Formation Metals

company_name.justification: Wallbridge Mining Company Limited (TSX:WM, OTCQB:WLBMF) (“Wallbridge” or the “Company”) is pleased to announce that it has entered into an option agreement (the “Option Agreement”) with Formation Metals Inc. (CSE:FOMO) (“Formation”)

interest_acquired_percent.justification: granting Formation an option to acquire a one hundred percent (100%) ownership interest in and to the Company’s N2 property (the “Property”)

primary_commodity.justification: The N2 property hosts two historical non 43-101 compliant resources: 18.2 Mt grading 1.48 g/t Au (~810,000 oz Au) across four zones (A, East, RJ-East, and Central) and 243 Kt grading 7.82 g/t Au (~65,000 oz Au) across the RJ zone

verified_article_link.justification: No article link was provided in the source documents.

currency.justification: Pursuant to the Option Agreement, and subject to the approval of the Canadian Securities Exchange, Formation may acquire a 100% interest in the Property by making payments totaling $550,000 in cash... The companies involved are listed on Canadian exchanges (TSX, CSE) and the project is in Quebec, implying the currency is CAD.

cash_payments_raw.justification: Formation may acquire a 100% interest in the Property by making payments totaling $550,000 in cash...

share_payments_raw.justification: The transaction consideration is broken down into cash payments, share issuances, and work commitments. A dollar value for the share component is not provided.

cash_and_share_payments_combined_raw.justification: The cash and share components of the transaction are listed separately, not as a combined value.

amount_of_shares_issued.justification: issuing an aggregate of 4,000,000 common shares in the capital of the Formation to Wallbridge

share_warrant_payments_raw.justification: No share warrants are mentioned as part of the transaction terms.

option_payments_raw.justification: While the agreement is an option agreement, there are no payments for options as part of the consideration.

issued_share_price.justification: The transaction terms mention the number of shares issued (4,000,000), but not the price. Using the last traded price for the buyer (Formation Metals Inc.) as a fallback, as seen in the detailed quote: 'Last: 0.39'.

exploration_commitment_meters.justification: The exploration commitment is specified as a monetary value, not in meters of drilling.

nsr_acquired_percent.justification: No Net Smelter Royalty (NSR) is mentioned as being acquired or retained in the transaction terms.
